subject: Environmental Studies
stem: When the north pole of one bar magnet is brought close to the north pole of another bar magnet, they push apart, but a north pole and a south pole pull together. This behaviour follows the rule that:

options.option_text: Like poles repel, unlike poles attract
Like poles attract, unlike poles repel
All poles always attract regardless of type
Magnetic poles have no effect on each other

explanation: The fundamental law of magnetism is that like poles (N-N or S-S) repel each other, while unlike poles (N-S) attract — the same underlying principle that lets a compass needle align with Earth's magnetic field.
